scientific_integrity: Explicit conjugacy and counting proof with a quantitative saddle bound; finite enumerations are corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field linear Lie algebra homomorphisms only; the asymptotic holds for fixed field order and growing number of generators. Earlier work supplies universal homomorphism parameterization. Publication-priority uniqueness is not certified.
title: Free class-two Lie retractions: exact conjugacy spectra and two-rank concentration
